name: kb-ai-audit
description: Audit a help center for AI customer-service readiness. Pulls every article (Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, Gorgias, Freshdesk, or any other via crawl), grades each one A+ to F against 13 plain-language checks, adds a help-center-wide coherence layer (coverage gaps, contradictions, near-duplicates, freshness, confusable names), shows what to fix first, produces a branded PDF report, and on request rewrites articles in the help center's own voice — as a Markdown pack or pushed back as drafts via API.
